description: This file defines callback function types and a configuration structure for EasyConnect (EC) operations related to Wi-Fi mesh networking, including message sending, scanning, and configuration retrieval.

classes.name: ec_ops_t
classes.description: A struct aggregating optional callback functions for EasyConnect operations, such as message sending, scanning, and configuration retrieval.

methods.name: send_bss_config_req_func
methods.description: Function type for sending BSS configuration request messages.

methods.name: send_autoconf_search_func
methods.description: Function type for sending extended autoconf search messages.

methods.name: send_autoconf_search_resp_func
methods.description: Function type for sending extended autoconf search response messages.

methods.name: send_chirp_func
methods.description: Function type for sending chirp notifications.

methods.name: send_encap_dpp_func
methods.description: Function type for sending proxied encapsulated DPP messages.

methods.name: send_dir_encap_dpp_func
methods.description: Function type for sending direct encapsulated DPP messages.

methods.name: send_1905_eapol_encap_func
methods.description: Function type for sending 1905 EAPOL encapsulated messages.

methods.name: send_act_frame_func
methods.description: Function type for sending action frames.

methods.name: toggle_cce_func
methods.description: Function type for setting CCE IEs in beacon and probe response frames.

methods.name: trigger_sta_scan_func
methods.description: Function type for triggering a station interface scan.

methods.name: bsta_connect_func
methods.description: Function type for connecting a backhaul STA to a BSS.

methods.name: get_backhaul_sta_info_func
methods.description: Function type for creating a DPP configuration response for backhaul STA.

methods.name: get_1905_info_func
methods.description: Function type for creating a DPP configuration response for 1905.1 interface.

methods.name: get_fbss_info_func
methods.description: Function type for creating a DPP configuration response for fronthaul BSS interface.

methods.name: can_onboard_additional_aps_func
methods.description: Function type to determine if additional APs can be onboarded into the mesh.

methods.name: ec_ops_t
methods.description: Structure holding optional callback functions for various EC operations.
